title: Finance Business Controller/Senior FP&A Expert
full_description:
Makati City, Philippines
Location:Makati, PhilippinesWork Schedule:Aligns with Central European Time (CET)Department:COO Finance – Finance AdvisoryReporting:Functionally to Global Finance
About ING and ING Hubs Philippines:
ING Hubs Philippines is an integral part of ING’s global network, delivering services to multiple business units worldwide across Wholesale and Retail Banking. At ING, our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe sustainable progress is driven by people with imagination and determination to create a better future.
Working at ING means joining a diverse, dynamic environment where challenges are never the same, and opportunities for growth are abundant. If you thrive in a continuously evolving landscape and want to help shape the future of banking, we’d love to meet you!
Why This Role Matters
This is not just a finance role—it’s a strategic seat at the table. As part of our global FP&A and Finance Advisory team, you will influence decisions that shape ING’s future, provide insights that drive performance, and partner with senior leaders to deliver sustainable growth.
If you are passionate about turning data into strategy, optimizing performance, and adding real business value, this is the opportunity for you.
We are seeking Finance Controllers, Business Controllers (FP&A), and Finance Business Partners to join our growing team. These roles will support Functions and Products globally, acting as trusted advisors and strategic partners to senior stakeholders.
In this role, as an extended global finance team, you will connect with diverse stakeholders worldwide, providing financial insights, performance analysis, and decision support to enable sustainable business growth and operational excellence.
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A):Prepare and analyze budgets, forecasts, and long-term plans.Deliver variance analysis and actionable insights to management.
Prepare and analyze budgets, forecasts, and long-term plans.
Deliver variance analysis and actionable insights to management.
Business Partnering:Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, influencing decisions through data-driven insights.Collaborate with global teams to align financial strategies with business objectives.
Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, influencing decisions through data-driven insights.

Performance Management:Drive initiatives to optimize financial performance and resource utilization.Support transformation projects and process improvements.
Drive initiatives to optimize financial performance and resource utilization.
Support transformation projects and process improvements.
What We’re Looking For
Strong knowledge offinancial planning, analysis, and controlling principles.
Proficiency inExcel (Advanced), financial modeling, and data visualization tools(Power Query and Power BI).
Functional experience in Essbase, PAFE (Planning Analytics for Excel), SmartView, Hyperion, TM1, or similar tools for managing multi-dimensional data.
DAX and SQLfor advanced data manipulation and reporting.
Experience withERP systems(SAP, Oracle) and reporting tools.
Strong business acumen in the banking industry, with a solid understanding ofbank products, markets, and financial drivers(advantage).
Executive Stakeholder Management:Ability to work with senior leaders and influence decisions under high urgency.
Global Mindset:Experience in multinational organizations with diverse stakeholders and cross-border collaboration.
Presentation & Visualization Skills:Ability to present the right information clearly and effectively, using visual storytelling for executive audiences.
Thrives in High-Pressure Environments:Comfortable managing competing priorities and delivering results under tight deadlines.
Business Acumen:Ability to connect financial insights to strategic decisions.
Analytical Thinking:Skilled in interpreting complex data and presenting clear recommendations.
Communication & Influence:Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
Adaptability:Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment.
Collaboration:Team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field, Experience in banking, particularly Retail and Wholesale Banking, is a plus
Professional certifications (CPA, CMA, CFA) are an advantage.
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in FP&A, Controlling, or Business Partnering.
Passion for continuous improvement and driving efficiency through automation.
Open to candidates from other industries with strong technical and analytical capabilities.
